title: Storytime split-screen: the tiger who got a second chance
caption:
Instead of a cage, a new home.

WWF filmed this release of a young male labelled a 'conflict tiger' in a prey-depleted area of the Russian Far East.

Source: WWF footage on Wikimedia Commons; Britannica.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
